test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Hit a brick wall
solution:
The correct answer is **"Encounter an obstacle"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the word "**Hit a brick wall" **and other words given in the options.

 
 
• **Hit a brick wall **means unable to continue or make progress because of a hindrance.

 
 
• **Example:- **The discussions in Brussels hit a brick wall.
 
 
 
• **Use unfair tactics **means actions that are not fair and dishonest.
 
 
• **Example**:- Students are advised not to use unfair tactics to score better on the surprise test.
 
 
 
• **Go to sleep** means falling asleep
 
 
• **​Example:- **All children were requested to go to sleep before 10 pm.
 
 
 
• **Encounter an obstacle **means facing roadblocks or problems while doing any task.
 
 
• **Example**:- He encountered many obstacles in his field,
 
 
 
• **Hit someone with a brick **means to go out on strike.
 
 
• **Example:- **After the Government's decision to reduce MSP all the farmers are ready to hit with a brick.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option no 3 i.e. **Encounter an obstacle****.**
